meal.title: Define a simple class
meal.objective: Write the Python syntax that creates an empty class

voice.script:
What if you could build a factory that makes anything you imagine? How do you write a blueprint for a new kind of object? In Python, the class keyword tells Python to start a blueprint definition. Think of it like setting up a factory called Car where each car will be built later. 
 pass. That single line defines a new type you can use later. An empty class is just the keyword and a name, ready to be filled. Try writing a class called Student with no contents.
